SELECT E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, D.DEPT_NM, JG.JOB_GRD_NM, JP.JOB_PSTN_NM, F.SAVE_PATH_NM || '/' || F.SAVE_FILE_NM AS PROFILE_IMAGE_URL FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE JG ON JG.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_CLSF AC ON AC.ATCH_FILE_ID = E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL F ON F.ATCH_FILE_ID = AC.ATCH_FILE_ID AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE E.ENABLED = 'Y'
AND ( E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR D.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR JG.JOB_GRD_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND E.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
ORDER BY D.DEPT_NM, E.EMP_NM ASC
